sqlMap.select: SELECT DTS_INSERT, DTS_JOBDATE, ID_USER, CD_JOB, CD_COMPANY, CD_PARTNER, NO_DEPOSIT, CD_BANK, NM_DEPOSIT, USE_YN, NO_DEPOSIT_N, CD_BANK_N, NM_DEPOSIT_N, USE_YN_N FROM EAI.ERP_PARTNER_DEPOSIT_R WHERE CD_COMPANY = #CD_COMPANY# AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY CREATE_DATE
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.ERP_PARTNER_DEPOSIT_R SET IF_FLAG = #IF_FLAG# , IF_DATE = SYSDATE , IF_MSG = #ERROR_MSG# , NO_DEPOSIT = CASE #IF_FLAG# WHEN 'Y' THEN '***' ELSE NO_DEPOSIT END , CD_BANK = CASE #IF_FLAG# WHEN 'Y' THEN '***' ELSE CD_BANK END , NM_DEPOSIT = CASE #IF_FLAG# WHEN 'Y' THEN '***' ELSE NM_DEPOSIT END , NO_DEPOSIT_N = CASE #IF_FLAG# WHEN 'Y' THEN '***' ELSE NO_DEPOSIT_N END , CD_BANK_N = CASE #IF_FLAG# WHEN 'Y' THEN '***' ELSE CD_BANK_N END , NM_DEPOSIT_N = CASE #IF_FLAG# WHEN 'Y' THEN '***' ELSE NM_DEPOSIT_N END WHERE DTS_INSERT = #DTS_INSERT# AND DTS_JOBDATE = #DTS_JOBDATE# AND ID_USER = #ID_USER# AND CD_JOB = #CD_JOB# AND CD_COMPANY = #CD_COMPANY# AND CD_PARTNER = #CD_PARTNER#

UPDATE ACNTSUPL SET BANK_CD = #BANK_CD# , BANK_ACCOUNT_NO = #BANK_ACCOUNT_NO# , DEPOSITOR = #DEPOSITOR# , CONFIRM_MOD_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , CONFIRM_USER_ID = CASE #ID_USER# WHEN 'SYSTEM' THEN 'FTP' ELSE 'KEP' || #ID_USER# END WHERE SUPPLIER = (SELECT COM_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE IRS_NO = SUBSTR(#CD_PARTNER#,1,3) || '-' || SUBSTR(#CD_PARTNER#,4,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(#CD_PARTNER#,6,5) AND STATUS IN ('C','R') AND BUSINESS_COND = 'S')
